thick atmospheric haze — dense particulate suspending light into visible volumetric beams, distance fades into gradient
wind-driven dust haze — orange or amber dust streaming horizontally across the frame, sand-grain texture in the air
acid-rain fog — corrosive humid mist clinging to surfaces, vapor visible at ground level, oxidized streaks on materials
vapor streams from vents — geothermal or mechanical steam plumes rising at multiple points, catching light from below
clear cold air — no haze, infinite visibility, sharp detail at all depths, brittle precision
ash drift — fine dark particulate falling slowly through the frame, accumulating on horizontal surfaces, sky overcast
snow flurry — flakes drifting across the frame, partial visibility, white speckle texture against dark structures
ionized atmosphere — air charged with visible electrical micro-discharge, faint blue glow at sharp edges, hair-raising static energy
